messages:
mira: quick sync post-RFC: need to finalize appeal + rejoin behavior for canaries. i sketched two rejoin modes and an operator appeal flow.
kevin: thumbs up. key problems we hit before: stuck tiny allocations, no active probes, and noisy alerts.
rahul: propose passive vs active rejoin. passive = wait for normal traffic to exercise variant. active = scheduled synthetic or replayed probes that bypass current pct. active required if current_pct < probe_size_pct.
jen: note: mirror/replay has privacy concerns in Private. allow only synthetic or sanitized replays there.
mira: agreed. add probe budget and rate limits in rollout config so tenants don't get probed into overload.
kevin: also need dedupe for appeals so many requests don't spam the adjudicator. suggest per-rollout 15m dedupe window.
ops: telemetry asks: appeal.created, appeal.outcome, rejoin.probe.results, decision.changes with reason+confidence.
rahul: state machine: RUNNING -> SOFT_EVICTED -> PENDING_REJOIN -> RUNNING/HARD_BLOCKED. appeals can transition SOFT_EVICTED->PENDING_REJOIN if approved.
mira: operator roles: tenant-owner can request appeal; oncall can approve for non-critical routes; critical routes require operator approval. all actions audit-logged.
jen: console needs "why lost traffic" API returning latest decision, reason, confidence, and appeal status (redact probe payloads).
kevin: router should support hold_probe_slot flag when applying actions so adjudicator can reserve probe budget for rejoin.
ops: add runbook items: probe infra down -> defer rejoin; repeated appeals -> page after 3 in 1h.
mira: i'll update RFC with config snippet, audit retention rules, and appeal lifecycle diagram. follow-up tomorrow 11am to review PoC.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: ab_v99 started by @mira at 1767009950, variant b @ 3%
